home.aboutP1: PAA Empire Holdings is a diversified investment company focused on building, investing in, and developing businesses with the potential to create long-term value.
home.aboutP2: PAA operates across five core sectors — Agriculture, Food Processing & Manufacturing, Natural Materials, Trading, Import & Export, and Real Estate.
home.aboutP3: Rooted in Southeast Asia with a global outlook, PAA Empire Holdings seeks to unlock the potential of the region's resources, people, and production capabilities. We connect resources, production, technology, and markets, transforming existing potential into valuable businesses and building value chains designed to grow sustainably over time.
home.aboutP4: By developing interconnected and complementary businesses, PAA aims to create long-term value across the entire value chain — from raw materials, production, and processing to trade and international markets.
home.linkWhoText: A diversified investment company rooted in Southeast Asia, headquartered in Vientiane.
home.linkInvestText: We build, invest in, and develop complementary businesses designed to grow over time.
home.linkBizText: Five interconnected sectors spanning the value chain — from resources to global markets.

about.journeyP1: In 2023, a journey to Laos in search of opportunities in mining unexpectedly opened an entirely different path.
about.journeyP2: On the roads of Laos, among resource-rich lands and farmers bringing rubber latex to traders, we saw a simple opportunity: connect local resources to markets. From a first rubber collection point, operations expanded quickly. Into the cassava season, we continued building agricultural collection points. By the third year, that journey led P.A.A. into livestock — beginning with buffalo and cattle.
about.journeyP3: Every step began by observing a real need, seeing untapped value, and turning it into a business model that could grow for the long term. The history of P.A.A. is a story of entrepreneurship guided by insight and compassion — from the earliest trading activities to the aspiration to build an internationally minded group that creates lasting value for society.
about.milestonesIntro: Explore the milestones that have shaped the journey of P.A.A.
about.m2: A phase of growth and consolidation
about.m3: Entering agriculture with a distinctive focus: circular agriculture
about.m4: The origin of our five core values
about.firstGenP1: PAA began with agricultural trading in Laos — from rubber and cassava to livestock — where we learned to see opportunity in the region's existing resources.
about.firstGenP2: From trading, PAA gradually expanded into agriculture, processing, natural materials, import-export, and mutually reinforcing fields. Every step followed one consistent mindset: understand the resource, seize the opportunity, and turn it into businesses that create real value.
about.firstGenP3: We are the first generation of PAA. What we build is therefore not only businesses, but also the principles, values, and foundation for the generations that follow.
about.foundationP1: PAA believes that value created through business should reach beyond the enterprise itself.
about.foundationP2: As the company grows, our long-term direction is to establish the PAA Foundation — a fund dedicated to supporting communities in Southeast Asia and gradually expanding across Asia.
about.foundationP3: The foundation will focus on creating opportunity through education, entrepreneurship, sustainable livelihoods, and community development — especially where PAA is present and active.
about.foundationP4: Our aspiration is clear: build successful businesses, return a share of that success to society, and create more opportunity for the generations that follow.

investment.strategyIntro: When we invest, we look for where three things overlap.
investment.regionalText: We invest where Southeast Asia has a natural advantage.
investment.realValueText: We build businesses that turn resources into higher-value products and opportunities.
investment.capabilitiesText: The company can benefit from PAA's entrepreneurship, networks, market access and execution.
investment.overlapNote: Where regional potential, real value and PAA's capabilities meet — that is where we build businesses.
investment.themesTitle: Five themes with long-term growth and shared value

globalTrade.title: Global trade
globalTrade.subtitle: Global trade
globalTrade.body: Southeast Asia holds resources, production capacity, and a strategic position in global supply chains. PAA connects these advantages to international markets through trade, import-export, and cross-border value chains.

circular.title: Circular economy
circular.subtitle: Circular economy
circular.body: We see every resource as a value chain, not a single product. PAA develops models that maximize the use of raw materials, by-products, and resources in production.
circular.tagline: Use more. Waste less. Create more value.

zeroWaste.title: Zero waste & environment
zeroWaste.subtitle: Zero waste & environment
zeroWaste.body: What is waste in one industry can be feedstock for another. PAA seeks solutions that reduce waste, regenerate resources, and lessen environmental impact.
zeroWaste.tagline: Waste is a resource in the wrong place.

sharedValue.title: Shared value
sharedValue.subtitle: Shared community value
sharedValue.body: Sustainable growth is not measured by profit alone. PAA pursues models where our development also creates opportunity for workers, farmers, partners, and communities.
sharedValue.tagline: When we grow, others should grow with us.

valueAdded.title: Value-added production
valueAdded.subtitle: Elevating resource value
valueAdded.body: Southeast Asia has abundant resources yet often trades them as raw materials. PAA goes further — from feedstock to processing, products, brands, and international markets.

investment.themesClosing: Take what the region has. Add value. Waste less. Connect it to the world. Share the prosperity.
investment.ownershipIntro: We build with a long-term purpose.

buildGuide.title: We build and guide
buildGuide.text: As an owner, PAA does more than provide capital. We walk alongside each business — with direction, resources, networks, and market access — so every enterprise can grow independently and create lasting value.

seekDevelop.title: We seek to develop
seekDevelop.text: PAA seeks businesses and opportunities with real potential, strengthens their capabilities, connects them within value chains, and gradually brings them to larger markets.

facilitate.title: We facilitate a network
facilitate.text: We connect resources, people, technology, partners, and markets — an ecosystem where businesses reinforce one another and grow together.

investment.ownershipClosing: We are the first generation. What we build today — businesses, culture, principles, and relationships — is the foundation for the next. Our vision: build businesses whose value outlasts a single generation.

paaAgro.title: PAA Agro
paaAgro.tagline: An integrated agricultural platform across rubber, cassava and cattle in Lao PDR.
paaAgro.p1: PAA Agro is the originating operating company of PAA Empire Holdings. Founded in 2023 in Vientiane, it develops connected agricultural businesses — from rubber and cassava to cattle — linking land, production and markets across Lao PDR and the Mekong region.
paaAgro.p2: From plantation and collection to processing and market access, PAA Agro builds an integrated platform designed for long-term agricultural value in Lao PDR.
